reviews.summary: MMT is identified as Momentum Finance’s Sui token, but fresh unlock data is materially inconsistent and the reported November release cannot be verified as actually distributed or sold. Supply-overhang risk is plausible, but not confirmed enough for a definitive risk verdict.
materialRisks: Reported vesting sources conflict: one lists a 12.3M MMT unlock on December 4 (6.03% of circulating supply), while others list roughly 4.9M MMT on December 1 or December 4. ([terminalnox.com](https://terminalnox.com/unlocks/MMT?utm_source=openai))

A widely circulated claim of a roughly 252M MMT unlock on November 4, 2026 is unverified as to actual release, transfer, or market sale; it therefore cannot be treated as established current supply impact. ([coinmarketcap.com](https://coinmarketcap.com/cmc-ai/momentum-token/latest-updates/?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Asset identity is high-confidence: MMT/EUR matches Momentum Finance’s MMT token on Sui, the governance/utility token documented by the project. ([docs.mmt.finance](https://docs.mmt.finance/overview/mmt-token?utm_source=openai))

Official token documentation says investor allocations begin gradual unlocking after a 12-month cliff from the November 4, 2025 TGE, making late-2026 vesting a relevant context. ([docs.mmt.finance](https://docs.mmt.finance/overview/mmt-token?utm_source=openai))

A project-associated social mirror reports an emissions-funded “Momentum Ignition” campaign opened November 6 with up to 60M MMT in phase 1; independent confirmation of issuance mechanics was not found. ([teapaw.org](https://teapaw.org/mmtfinance?utm_source=openai))
No corroborated fresh exploit, protocol outage, exchange maintenance/delisting, or regulatory action affecting Momentum Finance/MMT was found in the reviewed sources.
